module.purpose: Provides the client-side integration for an embedded customer support chat, including authenticated customer configuration, responsive display behavior, feature gating, and widget loading.
module.summary: This client-side module conditionally loads an external support-chat script on eligible application pages. It derives customer identity and entitlement from the authenticated session, requests a server-generated email hash and application metadata, builds support links and issue-reporting actions, responds to viewport changes, and optionally opens the widget from a URL query parameter. Unpaid users receive an alternate contact form, while paid users receive the configured launcher.
module.businessContext:
Supports customer assistance, feedback collection, and issue reporting within the scheduling application.
If initialization or eligibility handling fails, customers may lose access to support channels or receive inappropriate support options.

assumptions.description: The component relies on next-auth session data and uses session.user.email, belongsToActiveTeam, and org.
NEXT_PUBLIC_WEBAPP_URL matches window.location.origin for the application domain.
NEXT_PUBLIC_PLAIN_CHAT_EXCLUDED_PATHS is a comma-separated list of path segments.
The hash API returns hash, email, appId, shortName, fullName, chatAvatarUrl, and userTier fields.
The Plain SDK exposes window.Plain before plainScriptLoaded invokes initialization.
Browser globals window and document are available when client-side effects and rendering require them.

ambiguities.question: What exact response schema and semantics does /api/plain-hash provide for optional customer fields?
What behavior does Plain.init perform with the generated configuration?
What qualifies a session as an active paid user beyond belongsToActiveTeam or org truthiness?

moduleContractTests.scenario: The component is rendered outside the configured web application origin or on an excluded path.
moduleContractTests.rationale: Prevents the support widget from appearing outside permitted application routes.

moduleContractTests.scenario: An eligible app-domain user is not associated with an active team or organization.
moduleContractTests.rationale: Unauthenticated or unpaid users receive the fallback contact experience instead of Plain Chat.

moduleContractTests.scenario: An eligible paid user receives a valid response from the hash endpoint and the Plain script loads.
moduleContractTests.then: Plain.init(config) is called with the generated customer details and chat configuration
moduleContractTests.rationale: Pins the wire contract between the API response, script loader, and Plain initialization.

moduleContractTests.scenario: The viewport width is below the mobile breakpoint while Plain is already loaded.
moduleContractTests.then: the #plain-container element is removed, window.Plain is undefined, and PlainChat returns null
moduleContractTests.rationale: Guards the mobile restriction and cleanup behavior.

moduleContractTests.scenario: The user is on /event-types with the openPlain query parameter and Plain has loaded.
moduleContractTests.then: window.Plain.open() is called after the initialization delay
moduleContractTests.rationale: Preserves the deep-link behavior for opening the support chat.
